title: Home Mortgage Loans: Private Mortgage Insurance Removal Thresholds
content:
# Home Mortgage Loans: Private Mortgage Insurance Removal Thresholds

Within Home Mortgage Loans, private mortgage insurance exists only in the programs that can require it. For those programs this card fixes four thresholds: the loan-to-value at which a borrower becomes able to ask for cancellation, the scheduled loan-to-value at which the coverage ends by itself, and two look-back periods of clean payment history that a borrower-initiated cancellation depends on.

## The four thresholds

- **Request threshold** — the loan-to-value, measured against the original property value, at or below which the borrower may ask for cancellation.
- **Automatic termination threshold** — the loan-to-value on the amortization schedule, again against the original value, at which the insurance ends without any request.
- **30-day look-back** — the count of months, reaching back from the request, during which no payment may have been 30 or more days late.
- **60-day look-back** — the count of months, reaching back from the request, during which no payment may have been 60 or more days late.

| Program | Request threshold (% of original value) | Automatic termination (% of original value) | 30-day look-back (months) | 60-day look-back (months) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FHA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | none (no PMI in this program) | none | none | none |
| VA 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | none (program has no PMI) | none | none | none |
| Conventional 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 | 78 | 12 | 24 |
| Conventional 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 80 | 78 | 12 | 24 |
| 7/6 SOFR Adjustable-Rate Mortgage | 80 | 78 | 12 | 24 |
| Jumbo 30-Year Fixed Mortgage | none (PMI is never charged here) | none | none | none |

## Points of judgement

- The three programs that can carry private mortgage insurance share identical thresholds, so a figure read for one of them holds for the other two.
- The automatic threshold, 78 percent, is lower than the request threshold, 80 percent: a borrower may ask for removal at 80 percent before the schedule would end the coverage on its own at 78 percent.
- The two look-back periods overlap. The 12-month window for 30-day lateness sits inside the 24-month window for 60-day lateness, both ending at the request.

**Hypothetical reading.** Imagine a conventional loan whose balance stands at 79.40 percent of the original property value. That figure is at or below 80, so a request is possible on value grounds, while the automatic threshold of 78 has not been reached. The percentage in this example is made up for illustration.
